gateway_autopay.config.help: Register your own Autopay Partner Service at https://portal.autopay.eu/ to get your Service ID, shared key, and gateway URL, then enter them here. Then set your Partner Service return address to https://<your-shop-host>/api/gateway_autopay/return.
gateway_autopay.description: Accept hosted PLN payments (bank transfers, BLIK, cards) via Autopay Online.
gateway_autopay.errors.cancelFailed: Autopay could not cancel this payment. It may already be settled — try a refund instead. ({reason})
gateway_autopay.errors.cancelPartial: Autopay only partially cancelled this payment ({reason}) and no settled payment was found — this needs to be resolved manually before treating it as cancelled.
gateway_autopay.errors.captureUnsupporte: Autopay does not support capturing a payment separately — it settles immediately when the payer completes the redirect.
gateway_autopay.errors.customerEmailRequ: Autopay requires a customer email address for every payment session.
gateway_autopay.errors.plnOnly: Autopay only supports PLN payments in this integration.
gateway_autopay.errors.refundNotSettled: Autopay cannot refund session {sessionId}: no captured transaction was found (current status: {status}).
gateway_autopay.errors.refundPending: The refund request was accepted by Autopay and is being processed. Check back shortly to confirm it completed.
gateway_autopay.health.connectionFailed: Autopay connection failed. Check the Service ID, shared key and payment initiation URL, then try again.
gateway_autopay.health.gatewayUrlMissing: Autopay Payment Initiation URL is not configured.
gateway_autopay.health.serviceIdMissing: Autopay Service ID is not configured.
gateway_autopay.health.sharedKeyMissing: Autopay Shared Key is not configured.
gateway_autopay.launch.redirecting: Redirecting you to Autopay to complete the payment. If nothing happens, use the button below.
gateway_autopay.launch.title: Redirecting to Autopay
gateway_autopay.launch.unavailable: This payment link is invalid, has expired, or the payment is no longer pending. Go back to the shop and start the payment again.
gateway_autopay.return.done: You can close this window and return to the shop.
gateway_autopay.return.unavailable: We could not match this return to a payment. Go back to the shop to check the payment status.
gateway_autopay.title: Autopay
